holder_stl.units_authority: inferred from coherent 107 mm assembly envelope and decimal mechanical features; STL carries no units metadata

visual_reference.relationship: user-supplied clearance-design visual; not asserted to be a render of the bound STL

horizontal_open_tunnel.section: vertical sides to the centerline plus an R4.875 semicircular roof; not a full circular bore
horizontal_open_tunnel.station_orientation: four outer tunnels open radially/cardinally; the center tunnel opens along +X/-Y into the southeast re-entrant corner

interpretation.classification: five-station compliant split-holder with perpendicular L-shaped loading/retention voids

candidate_antenna_envelope.authority: conservative derived envelope; not a measured antenna or vendor drawing

reference_holder_nested_fit.note: The split holder can flex around these nested envelopes. Its D9.75/D8.75 voids must not be copied into a rigid closed pocket.

feature_frame_comparison.authority: feature-frame comparison only; not a placement or substitution of the complete holder STL

prewired_cable_loading_path.loading_method: complete L-shaped antenna and already-attached cable translate vertically through one rectangular underside opening as the adapter is lowered
prewired_cable_loading_path.cable_exit_direction: south / negative Y, horizontal on the exterior/top side of the PCB enclosure
prewired_cable_loading_path.pcb_lid_below_mount: closed except for the two insert/screw fastener stacks; no antenna-cable pass-through
prewired_cable_loading_path.authority: candidate envelope and user-directed assembly topology; actual cable OD/termination remain unmeasured

method.topology: dependency-free binary STL facet/edge audit at 1e-6 mm vertex quantization
method.dimensions: axis-aligned bounds, horizontal plane sections, cylinder-axis fitting, and surface-transition inspection
method.nested_fit_rule: radial delta = (candidate antenna diameter - holder void diameter) / 2

excluded_claims: The holder STL does not authoritatively measure the antenna.
It does not provide antenna body length, elbow fillet, connector size/gender, cable diameter, or bend radius.
The 2.50 mm cable and its 6.50 mm flared U-channel entry are candidate clearance witnesses, not measurements of the attached production cable or termination.
The modeled 0.40 mm radial clearance and 0.20 mm lid-floor gap do not prove physical retention, rattle resistance, or printer-process fit.
The visual reference is not asserted to depict the exact bound STL.
Derived-envelope collision clearance is not physical fit or PRINT_VERIFIED evidence.
